address: 30 West Hill Road, West Cliff, Bournemouth,BH2 5PH
bio: Treat yourself to a delicious afternoon tea at The Connaught Hotel and Spa. Enjoy a selection of sweet and savoury treats in this boutique hotel, located just a few minutes' walk from Bournemouth Pier and a five minute walk from the town centre.  Enjoy afternoon tea by an open fire on a cold winter's night, or in the summer months bask in the sun in your choice of garden terraces. Make it a special occasion with a glass of prosecco, champagne or a G&T!  Vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free afternoon tea options are all available.
